verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe shows https://openrouter.ai/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is directly downloadable. A machine-readable llms.txt and a documented, normalized API schema add to this. missing for 10: first-party docs that describe or link the OpenAPI spec, and evidence about the spec's coverage and completeness across endpoints.
